text:
maya: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — we need to lock owners and timelines for the remediation items that affect SLOs. Short list below, please ACK and add ETA.

maya: action A: 'kv-cache eviction policy tweak' -> owner? impact: 95th latency blip, eats error budget when traffic spikes.

jack: I can take action A. aiming EOD Thursday for a config change + canary.

anika: action B: 'dashboard alerts: split latency by model shard + add burn-rate alert' -> PM wants a visible alert for >2x burn in 10m. Owner?

liam: I'll do the dashboard changes. ETA Monday. Can we scope the alert? propose: burn_rate >= 2 for 10m AND p95 > 180ms.

maya: @liam please add runbook link and add a test alert in staging first. for runbook: https://confluence.redwood/incident/runbooks/slo-burn; include playbook steps.

jack: +1 on canary, will add feature flag so Dedicated customers don't see transient changes. will post canary logs here.

sre-bot: Deploy queued: config/kv-evict-v2 -> staging at 2024-11-06T09:00Z (job 4729).

anika: action C: 'SLO recalibration proposal' — after the fixes, we should propose new target for p95 to PM/ops: current p95 target 150ms, observed steady-state 170ms with recent model mix. Draft due by Fri. who owns writeup?

maya: I'll draft the SLO note with cost/latency tradeoffs. Will include: rollbacks, grace period, and error budget policy adjustments. Target to circulate by Friday noon.

liam: question on measurement windows — do we keep 28d rolling for error budget or switch to 14d for faster feedback? ops preference?

anika: ops prefers 14d for now (faster detection) but we should call it out in the SLO proposal.

jack: quick FYI: found a recurring pattern in logs where model shard 3 has 2x queue wait during bursts. patch in review to rebalance. might reduce p95 by ~10-12ms once live.

maya: good catch. add that as action D: 'rebalance shard hot-spot' -> owner @jack, ETA next Wednesday.

sre-bot: Note: error budget remaining for service/inference: 73% (calculated at 2024-11-05T08:30Z).

anika: ok team — summary: owners locked: A:jack (EOD Thu), B:liam (Mon), C:maya (Fri noon), D:jack (Wed). I'll convert this into GH issues and link PRs. will ping owners when created.

maya: ACK. please add labels: postmortem, slo, priority/high. also add a milestone 'pm-followups-2024-11'.

jack: ACK. will open the eviction policy PR and attach canary logs here when available.

liam: ACK. will add test dashboard screenshot in the PR.

anika: leaving a note for leadership: we'll likely recommend keeping current SLA but tighten alerting and shorten measurement windows. final SLO proposal dependent on results of canary + rebalance.

maya: Thanks all. quick check-in scheduled tomorrow 10:30 PT to ensure canary started. if anything blocks owners, flag here. :thumbsup:

jack: I'll post canary logs after the staging deploy completes.

liam: will start dashboard changes after lunch.

sre-bot: Reminder: weekly SLO review meeting tomorrow 16:00 UTC.
